decisions.quote: The School Climate Measure ( SCM ) was developed and validated in 2010 in response to a dearth of psychometrically sound school climate instruments. This study sought to further validate the SCM on a large, diverse sample of Arizona public school adolescents (N = 20,953).
decisions.reason: Prior adjudication and state files were checked and are absent for this never-adjudicated work. The supplied primary source (10.1111/josh.12124) is abstract-only and states that the School Climate Measure (SCM) was developed and validated in 2010 and that the present study sought to further validate four SCM domains using confirmatory factor analysis and structural equation modeling in a new sample (N = 20,953). Shipped row 72 (Zullig, Koopman, Patton, & Ubbes, 2010, 'School Climate: Historical Review, Instrument Development, and School Assessment', 10.1177/0734282909344205, verified in Crossref metadata) shares publication year 2010, topic, and authors Keith J. Zullig and Jon M. Patton, making it a strong candidate match. However, because the primary text is restricted to the abstract and supplies no in-text citation, author names, title, DOI, or reference list for the 2010 validation study (and Luna's triage disposition was mechanically invalid), the available primary evidence cannot positively settle the target's bibliographic identity or definitively confirm report equivalence with shipped row 72 rather than another 2010 report; unseen full text does not justify an exclusion.
